 SUNY waives application fees to boost enrollment 
 By Jolie Jenkins Published : Oct. 26, 2026 at 6:48 PM EDT | Updated : 12 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google ALBANY, N.Y. (WBNG) -- New York is offering a free period to apply to SUNY schools. 
 Students can apply to up to five campuses for free now through midnight on Nov. 2, 2026.
 “Importantly, for first-generation students, low-income students, students in high-needs rural communities, students who might not always get the level of support that they need around the college application process, this makes it much simpler for them to get the information they need,” said SUNY Chancellor John B. King Jr.
 Each application normally costs $50, so families can save up to $250. Students can also apply for financial aid through FAFSA.
 “Rather than spending $50 on each application, they save $250, and they check that task off their list,” King said.
 King says the effort is meant to make applying a little easier. He says applications and enrollment have grown every year in the five years since it began.
 “We worry that sometimes the college application process can seem burdensome, confusing, hard to navigate,” King said. “We want to make it straightforward for folks, and so this free application period does that.”
 Those interested can visit www.suny.edu/applysuny/ to get started.
